blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A bus carrying Filipino tourists veered off a highway west of the German city of Munich and overturned, killing at least two people and seriously injuring at least eight others, German state media reported on Sunday. The coach left the road on a highway near Buchloe in the Ostallgäu region around 6 a.m. local time (about noon in Manila), news agency dpa reported, citing German officials. Investigators were looking into the cause of the crash, which was not immediately clear.
